sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r12/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only, in memory): sheet 'Quality Checks' row #30 and sheet 'Internal Quality Checks' row #30 (negative_checks_have_positive_controls: 'Any rejects / hides / absent check is paired with the matching success case, so a totally broken app can't earn it.'; no extra internal annotation column populated)
qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md (full, incl. 'A negative needs a successful control')
evidence: Every refusal/absence/unchanged leg in the frozen criteria is paired with a matching success inside the same criterion, and functional prompt.md:13 adds a global rule: 'Every refusal row needs its own positive control: a successful action of the same kind, observed in this review.' prompt.md:17 further requires role replays to be legal fresh requests, sent again as Rafael as the control, and says a refusal for staleness/duplicate/skip/full stage does not count as the role refusal. Per-criterion pairing (functional/judge.toml): hro_job_open ('the successful opening is the control'); hro_add_email_rules ('The same address on a different job is accepted (the control)'); hro_move_one_stage (skip refused vs one-stage forward/back working); hro_reject_reason (blank refused vs reasoned reject moves card); hro_reject_hired ('A rejection of a non-hired card is the control'); hro_reopen (other stage refused vs own-stage reopen + undo); hro_interview_full ('the two cards that entered Interview are the control'); hro_undo_full ('the same-kind control'); hro_refused_put_back (requires reason shown + focus, positive evidence a blank app lacks); hro_mgr_early_refused ('their late-stage moves are the control'; open-job/add-candidate refusals controlled by Rafael's replayed requests per prompt.md:17 and protocol N prompt.md:37); hro_mgr_other_job ('the job's own manager's move is the control'); hro_observer_readonly ('Rafael's identical successful requests are the control'); hro_candidate_no_staff (explicit session control + same-kind staff control, 'makes this row 0'); hro_anonymous ('A signed-in success of each is the control'); hro_refusal_status (controls 'as named in its own row' plus global prompt.md:13 rule); hro_stale_refused ('The original successful move is the control'); hro_bulk_all_or_none / hro_bulk_places / hro_undo_conflict / hro_undo_once (named successful controls); hro_activity_refusals ('The successful actions' lines are the control'); hro_notes (other manager refused vs Recruiter + own manager notes succeed, Observer reads); hro_msg_compose ('A normal send is the control' for blank refusal and literal <b>); hro_thread_access ('Rafael's own read and send are the controls'); hro_candidate_private (own data loads 'the control'; 'A candidate page that receives none of its own data is 0'); hro_unread_counts / hro_unread_scrolled_up / hro_seen (non-increase / not-moved / not-yet-seen paired with rise, notice and later seen within 15 s); hro_drafts and hro_restart (no-leak / not-reloaded paired with retained data). Polish: hro_pol_live_board and hro_pol_live_thread zero the row when no update arrives ('preservation cannot be shown and this row is 0'); hro_pol_failed_send ('send again: it is sent once'); hro_pol_session_resume (positive control explicitly named; Mei-empty paired with Rafael drafts still there). Gates: render 'A valid sign-in immediately after the invalid attempt is the required positive control' (gates/render/prompt.md:9); constraints gate is all-positive and excludes static/no-op/browser-only saves. Visual likert rows have no negative legs. Broken-app probe: a blank/static shell, empty DB or login screen fails both gates and functional prompt.md:13 zeroes every binary row; a dead-but-gated app that refuses every move/reject/undo cannot earn any refusal row because each needs the same-kind success. Conforming-alternative probe: apps that hide refused controls are protected ('hiding it is optional', 'Whether a refused action is offered at all is the app's choice', prompt.md:23) so no conforming app fails for refusing in the UI rather than the server. Residual P3 observation (not raised to Fail): hro_observer_readonly, hro_mgr_other_job (Bill) and the Ingrid/Aud/Noor legs of hro_thread_access do not, inside the criterion, require that the refused actor's own session is valid, unlike hro_candidate_no_staff which states the session control explicitly. An app whose Observer (or Bill) sign-in is broken could in principle have replays answered 401 from a non-session and be read as 'refused, nothing changed'. Mitigations: replays are 'in that person's session' (prompt.md:17/23/45), prompt.md:17 says 'only the rule or role under test can cause a refusal', hro_refusal_status requires 403 for these actors, and the Observer/Bill must succeed in hro_notes/hro_activity/hro_seen/hro_thread_access. Exposure about weight 1-2 of the functional sum. Risk=true because this latent gap is unresolved and no configured judge run or weak-app judge run exercised these controls; raw-evidence-index scope states 'Full configured grading/workload, reward discrimination/ranking and Oracle/target scores are absent'.
suggested_fix: Optional hardening: add to hro_observer_readonly and hro_mgr_other_job (and the Ingrid/Aud/Noor legs of hro_thread_access) a session control such as 'the actor first signs in and their own permitted read loads in that same session; a refusal because the actor has no valid session (401) does not count', mirroring hro_candidate_no_staff.
